editorial.message: 'Reports 3,060 heap fetches ... even though the stored visibility input has not caught up' reads as a contradiction. The stale all-visible count (163 of 163) is why the planner priced almost no heap visits while execution still fetched 3,060.
The closing caution about equal results under different null conditions is not spelled out in the source; say only that NOT IN keeps a SubPlan even on NOT NULL columns.
Plan-time pruning applies only while enable_partition_pruning is on and quals exist; the narration states pruning without that condition.
Merge join 'uses compatible merge clauses' omits that a FULL join can also use a clauseless merge join.
The opening and question scenes both pose the 'how does the planner work' question in similar words.

summary: Reviewed all 296 targets (narration, screen lines, diagram edges) against the pinned document and glossary evidence. No contradictions, changed verbs, reversed edges, wrong values or invented numbers/examples were found; the 49 polarity_changed narrations preserve their source negations or drop only negations that do not alter meaning. Two minor wording issues (rewrites.n1 'side effects'; sublinks.n2 equal-results remark) and five minor editorial notes. Required caveats are retained in the narration.
